Where import sources read from (originals are only read).
text.가져올 프로젝트 폴더(`.claude/`·`.mcp.json`, 상대 경: Project folder to import from (`.claude/` and `.mcp.json`; relative paths are resolved from the settings file folder). Leave empty to use that folder.
Use this to import the .claude settings of another project.
Import source name → options that source accepts (the source defines the keys).
